apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

> **Everything new in this release is experimental and has been tried on only a few devices so far.** It may work great on yours, or it may not work at all. Either way, a log helps a lot.

## Fixed: games crashed at start on iOS and iPadOS 26 and older

- **0.1.682 crashed every game launch on iOS/iPadOS 26 and older.** It was the first release built with the iOS 27 SDK, and it used a system function that exists only from iOS 27. On older systems the game's start ended in a crash. Thanks to the players who sent crash reports and tested the fix.
- **If you went back to 0.1.665, you can update now:** install 0.1.686 over it as usual.
- New release checks now compare every system function BCD uses against older iOS versions, so this kind of mistake stops the build instead of reaching you.

## Launch options for Steam games (experimental)

- **Launch arguments for Steam games.** A Steam game's **Options › Launch › Launch arguments** now works like Steam's own Launch Options:
  - Started through BCD Dock, Steam hands the arguments to the game.
  - Started as **The game**, they come after Steam's own arguments for the program.
  - With the field empty, the game starts exactly as before.
- **New quick picks:** `-vulkan`, and Unity's `-force-vulkan`. The game also needs **Graphics › Vulkan (experimental)** turned on.
- **Mod loaders:** **Options › Windows › Components › Game's own copy first** loads DLLs such as an ASI loader's `dinput8.dll` or `version.dll` from the game's folder before Wine's own. This is the `WINEDLLOVERRIDES ...=n,b` of Proton guides.
- Tried on only a few games so far. If a game ignores its arguments or a mod does not load, please send a log.

## Epic games on an external drive (experimental)

- **An Epic game can install on a USB SSD.** While a drive is connected (**Settings › Storage › External drives**), an Epic game's page offers **External drive** beside **Install**. The game goes to the drive's **Epic Games** folder. **Install** still installs on this device.
- **If the drive is unplugged during the download,** the download stops and waits for it instead of filling your device. Play, Uninstall and cloud saves of such a game also wait for the drive.
- **Drive format:** use an exFAT or APFS drive. A FAT32 drive cannot hold files of 4 GB or more.
- Tried on only a few drives so far. Please send a log if anything goes wrong.

## iPhone Duo: a touchpad below the fold (experimental)

- **Turning it on:** switch on **Settings › Graphics › Foldable iPhone › Foldable iPhone support**, then half fold the phone with the inner display upright. The game stays above the fold, and the screen below it works as a touchpad.
- **Gestures:**
  - One finger moves the pointer.
  - A tap clicks.
  - Two fingers right-click and scroll.
  - Hold, then move, to drag.
  - The on-screen controls keep working.
- **Turning it off:** **Touchpad below the fold**, in the same place. Nothing changes on any other device.
- Checked in Apple's iPhone Duo simulator, not yet on a real iPhone Duo. If you have one, please send a log and tell us how it feels.

Install help, game reports and ideas: the BCD-Games Discord is open, https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug
